text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Hey, Rudolf. Does this go over here?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes, please. ...My thanks to both of you. 
Strictly speaking, this is Student Council 
work.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Don't sweat it! This is prep for the 
school-wide student mixer... right? I 
participate all the time anyway.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Doing this once in a while isn't bad at 
all. Plus, you end up finding interesting 
things like this.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Is that an album? Let me see, what 
kind of photos are in there... wait—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaaa! This photo of Rudolf... Could 
this be from before you became Student 
Council President?!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
How nostalgic. Weren't you called the 
'prodigy of the era' back then, or 
something?... Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Instructor A
text_block_list.text:
Next up for the physical fitness test— 
Symboli Rudolf! Take your mark!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Understood. —Hah...!

text_block_list.name: Instructor A
text_block_list.text:
! Th-This time is...! Unbelievable! It's 
on par with girls who have already 
debuted... no, even faster!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Racing has a history in Europe unique from 
ours in many ways.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Amazing... Her English is so fluent...! 
Winning the speech contest—and she's 
younger than us, right...?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
C.B., Ace. If you don't mind, shall we 
walk to the classroom together?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
As peers in the same grade, we are 
comrades striving to better each other. 
...I thought we might engage in some 
casual conversation along the way.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, works for me. We were just talking 
about you anyway.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly! We were just saying how 
incredible your achievements have been 
lately, Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Heheh... I can't afford to fall behind 
either. Once we both make our debuts, I 
won't let you have an easy win in races!

text_block_list.name: Senior Division Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, that's her, right? You know, the 
one everyone in the academy's talking 
about.

text_block_list.name: Senior Division Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
I heard the teachers have huge praise for 
her too. Saying she's fit to be the next 
Student Council President.

text_block_list.name: Senior Division Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
But isn't she from a prestigious family? 
Making her president because of that... 
kinda feels like favoritism, you know...?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...People are spreading weird rumors. I'm 
gonna go give them a piece of my mind.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It is quite alright, Katsuragi Ace. It is 
only natural.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That our upperclassmen have not yet 
acknowledged me is simply because I am 
still inexperienced.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Thus, having all eyes on me now is an 
opportunity... I shall make further 
strides and disprove all unfounded rumors.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I had a hunch back then. That you, Rudolf, 
were going to be someone truly 
extraordinary.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? Those words were nothing less 
than my true, unvarnished feelings.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Back then, I was still green. It was only 
reasonable that I had not yet earned our 
seniors' trust.

When I visited the Student Council room on 
an errand, I overheard the three of them 
warmly reminiscing about the past.
